explanations.content: The Scanner class provides several methods for reading different types of input: `nextByte()` reads a byte value, `nextInt()` reads an int, `nextFloat()`/`nextDouble()` read floating‑point numbers, `next()` reads the next token (delimited by whitespace), and `nextLine()` reads the remainder of the current line including the line‑separator. `next()` returns a token, so when a user enters a full name separated by a space, two calls to `next()` are needed to obtain both parts. `nextLine()` consumes the line‑separator that `print()` leaves, which is why output appears on the next line after a `print` call.
